contract.label: Sidebar
contract.summary: A composable application sidebar. SidebarProvider supplies collapse state; Sidebar holds a header, a scrollable body of grouped menus, and a footer, alongside a SidebarInset for the main area.
contract.purpose: The application navigation frame: a provider holding collapse state, a rail, and menus whose active item uses the component's own neutral highlight.
useWhen: Top-level navigation of the app shell.
Grouped, collapsible navigation that has to survive a route change.
dontUseWhen: The switch is between panels within one page — that is `tabs`.
The list is a set of actions on one element — that is a `dropdown-menu`.

parts.name: Sidebar
parts.description: The sidebar container; collapsible offcanvas, icon, or none.

parts.name: SidebarContent
parts.description: Scrollable body holding the navigation groups.

parts.name: SidebarFooter
parts.description: Bottom region, e.g. settings or the account menu.

parts.name: SidebarGroup
parts.description: A titled section of menu items.

parts.name: SidebarHeader
parts.description: Top region, typically the logo or workspace switcher.

parts.name: SidebarInset
parts.description: The main content area beside the sidebar.

parts.name: SidebarMenu
parts.description: The list of menu items within a group.

parts.name: SidebarMenuButton
parts.description: The interactive nav button; set isActive for the current page.

parts.name: SidebarMenuSubmenu
parts.description: A parent with subpages: an inline collapsible submenu when expanded, and an off-rail hover/focus flyout when the rail is collapsed to icons. Pass the parent button as `trigger` and the SidebarMenuSubItem rows as children. If the trigger renders something other than a <button> — a SidebarMenuButton with render={<Link />}, say — pass nativeButton={false} so Base UI does not warn on the collapsed-rail flyout.

parts.name: SidebarProvider
parts.description: Context provider owning open/collapsed state; wrap the whole layout.

parts.name: SidebarTrigger
parts.description: Button that toggles the sidebar open/collapsed.

requires: A `SidebarProvider` above any `Sidebar`; the collapse state lives there.
`SidebarMenuButton isActive` for the current item, so the active styling is the component's own.
A gap between menu items so an active item and a hovered neighbour never merge into one block.
forbids: Recolouring the active item with brand blue. The highlight is the neutral `sidebar-accent` surface, and the text and icon stay `foreground`.
Hand-rolling the highlight instead of composing `SidebarGroupLabel`, `SidebarMenuButton isActive`, and `SidebarMenuSub`.

behavior.loading: `SidebarMenuSkeleton` holds the menu's shape while its items load.

requirements: Items collapsed to icons keep an accessible name.

antiPatterns: Two parallel navigation patterns in one app shell.
